vo: In nineteen ninety, Tokyo was the undisputed largest city on Earth, a title it held for decades. But the cities of Asia and Africa were exploding. Delhi surged upward year after year. Shanghai, Dhaka and Cairo swelled into megacities. By twenty twenty-six, the map of human population has shifted dramatically. Which city rises next? Follow, for the numbers nobody explains.
